column4: dialect-gated: engine/a_sharded_store_knows_a_tenant_is_suspended_test.go's real-shard test reads a PostgreSQL shard and needs CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES (or CLEAT_TEST_DB), which this job (MySQL only, whole ./engine/) does not supply. The mock-shard tests in the same file run here. Measured 2026-10-30: env -u CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES -u CLEAT_TEST_DB -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL=<mysql> go test ./engine/ -run TestAShardedStore -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly this one test (cleat#3596).

same test as the multi-db/mysql line, same reason: this job supplies SQL Server only. Measured 2026-10-30 with env -u CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES -u CLEAT_TEST_DB -u CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL=<mssql>: the same one skip.
